messages:
jordan: :rotating_light: Opening war room — multiple customer escalations in EU hosted region. Seeing sustained 502/504 + timeouts since ~06:12 UTC. p95 latency jumped, lots of client retries. @maya are you oncall?
incident-bot: Alert: hosted-eu.gateway 5xx surge detected (06:12 → 06:27). p95 latency 1.2s → 6.8s. Top error: 504 Gateway Timeout. Alerts: https://alerts.redwood/8290001234
maya: oncall here. I see a spike in sidecar proxy errors and a token refresh error rate increase for some customers — auth refreshes returning 500 then causing client retries. Investigating token cache/thundering.
oliver: runtime team — looking at serving runtime logs, a few runtime pods hit KV cache OOM and long GC pauses around 05:55–06:10. Tail from runtime: ```[2026-03-17T06:08:02Z] ERROR backend_request.go:142 timeout waiting for response (30s) -> upstream=runtime-eu-12 id=0x9f3
[2026-03-17T06:08:03Z] WARN kvcache.go:211 eviction storm triggered, freed 120MB
[2026-03-17T06:08:03Z] ERROR http.gateway: 504 read timeout to runtime-eu-12
``` Likely correlated with PR#4321 kernel tweak that landed at 05:50.
liz: support: two paying customers (Acme Corp, NovaApps) just opened escalations — timeouts and billing noise from retries. They're asking for ETA and credits. Marking high priority for comms.
jordan: Immediate mitigations I propose: 1) Route premium customers to Dedicated EU pools temporarily. 2) Increase autoscaler max for runtime-eu by +25% to absorb surge. 3) Roll back kernel tweak PR#4321 (deployed 05:50). @oliver can you roll back and confirm?
oliver: rolling back PR#4321 now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime-eu --to-revision=3` — pods restarting, pulling older kernel config. Will monitor logs.
maya: autoscaler max bumped and routing override applied for pinned premium routes. Observed CPU on runtime pods drop and fewer 5xx after rollback — errors down from ~65% to ~28% in the last 5m. :thumbsup:
jordan: Great. Support action: @liz please send interim notice to Acme/NovaApps offering credits and explaining mitigation. Product: @ella please own the postmortem and timeline.
liz: Draft message ready, sending now. ETA update to customers in 30m.
oliver: root cause hypothesis: eviction/warmup race in kv-cache combined with a kernel scheduling tweak increased GC latency under burst. Opening action item to increase cache mem and add backpressure on auth refresh bursts.
jordan: Action items (owners + rough ETA): I1 rollback verification — oliver — due 8290001400; I2 autoscaler + mem tuning & longer cache warmup — maya & oliver — due 8290080000; I3 customer comms & credits — liz — due 8290001600; I4 postmortem doc + RCA — ella — due 8290100000. Draft postmortem: https://go/reports/pm-8290001234 :memo:
maya: reproducible test for eng: run burst test to emulate token-refresh storm: `ab -n 5000 -c 50 https://eu-hosted.api/v1/generate` and watch kvcache/eviction metrics and runtime GC. I'll attach logs to the postmortem.
jordan: I'll keep monitoring for 2hrs and will re-open war room if errors >10% sustained. Thanks everyone — closing active war room for now. :white_check_mark:
